title: HOUSE REALITY STACK
law: Index unequal layers around one addressed physical locus. Layer membership is a navigation/projection aid, never a new ontology or authority.

center.invariant: ADDRESS remains stable while layer, projection, tool and witness may change

axes.spatial_containment: BODY -> HARNESS -> OBJECT -> ROOM -> HOUSE -> NETWORK

layers.label: BODY
layers.question: What can the embodied human sense, reach, carry, tolerate or do here?
layers.authority: Human/body evidence; HOUSE selection is context only.

layers.label: HARNESS / ENV-0
layers.question: What bounded coupling lets a human carry capability, context, tools and feedback into the environment?
layers.authority: Interface/coupling projection only; no device, medical, structural or agent authority.

routes.label: ENV-0
routes.role: BODY -> GARMENT -> HARNESS -> SUIT -> FURNITURE -> ROOM -> HOUSE recovered grammar

layers.label: OBJECT / TOOL
layers.question: Which tool, fixture, furnishing or acquired capability participates in this operation?
layers.authority: Native object/procurement/fabrication owners retain lifecycle and physical truth.

layers.label: ROOM / LOCUS
layers.question: What is true at this exact spatial address, and what bounded change can be tried here?
layers.authority: HOUSE spatial address + local authored evidence; selection is not occupancy.

layers.label: HOUSE
layers.question: How do rooms, surfaces, objects, constraints and private runtime relate as one dwelling?
layers.authority: HOUSE spatial model coordinates; private HA/HOUSEBUS owns runtime actuation.

layers.label: NETWORK / RUNTIME
layers.question: Which sensors, entities, messages or runtimes can observe/act, under whose authority?
layers.authority: Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS private runtime; public HOUSE remains projection-only.

transverse.label: TIME / EXECUTION
transverse.question: When does the addressed operation happen and how does it re-enter?

transverse.label: PEOPLE / COMMS
transverse.question: Which other human carries obligation, interpretation, consent or consequence?

transverse.label: AGENT / COMPUTATION
transverse.question: Which computational worker may inspect, propose or transform, and what authority does it actually hold?

routes.label: FIELD
routes.role: held object + bounded moves + witness + return

transverse.label: EVIDENCE / RETURN
transverse.question: What observable consequence survives the operation and can be replayed or inspected?

harness_correspondence.shared: Both human and agent harnesses bound capability around a focused object, expose tools under constraints, and require feedback/RETURN before claims are promoted.
differences: Human embodiment, fatigue, comfort, proprioception and physical risk are irreducible to agent context windows.
Agent tools/permissions are explicit computational capabilities; human affordances are partly tacit and physical.
Neither harness grants authority merely by carrying context or exposing an action.

dynamicland.name: Dynamicland / Realtalk
dynamicland.transfer: Computation as a property of physical material; visible local objects/claims; environment rather than screen-centric interface.

habitat.name: Ink & Switch Habitat
habitat.transfer: Multiple computational/representational models can coexist in one environment.

playbook.name: Ink & Switch PlayBook
playbook.transfer: A small material vocabulary with distinct physics can bridge expressive work and programming.

patchwork.name: Ink & Switch Patchwork
patchwork.transfer: Low-ceremony branching, history and domain-specific visual diffs for reversible alternatives.

ambsheets.name: Ink & Switch Ambsheets
ambsheets.transfer: Possibility spaces and filters make multiple design scenarios inspectable without serial toggling.

roomplan.name: Apple RoomPlan
roomplan.transfer: Sensor-guided capture of walls, openings and recognized objects into a modifiable spatial model.

homeassistant.name: Home Assistant Areas / Floors
homeassistant.transfer: Physical area hierarchy as a targetable runtime organization layer, distinct from individual entities.

openusd.name: OpenUSD
openusd.transfer: Layered composition and overrides preserve source structure while supporting alternate projections/configurations.

ditto.name: Eclipse Ditto
ditto.transfer: Separate twin state, policy, search, gateway and connectivity responsibilities instead of one undifferentiated digital twin.

matter.name: Matter Semantic Tags
matter.transfer: Standard semantic location/direction/position tags can inform adapters without becoming HOUSE identity.
